synthesis:draft.headline: Operational demand is the regional demand measured/estimated for market and dispatch purposes that is met by scheduled, semi‑scheduled and significant non‑scheduled generation and imports [c1].
summary: Operational demand in a region is demand that is met by local scheduled, semi-scheduled and significant non-scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region, and includes Wholesale Demand Response [c1].
Operational demand generally excludes demand met by non-scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar generation and exempt generation [c2].
Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual WDR, and AEMO provides an aggregate WDR estimate in a separate EMMS field [c3].
The EMMS document describes native, operational and scheduled demand as the three key demand definitions based on “as generated” demand used operationally in the NEM [c4].
One retrieved passage contained instruction-like text (which was not followed) that said "Ignore all previous instructions..." and similar system prompts [c5].
